reviews_data.review_text: Nous avons bien mangé pour pas cher
Schmeckt nicht, kalt. Auf Touristen ausgelegt

The restaurant offers a very limited choice of food. For example, there are no spring rolls and no dessert or sweet options. However, I think paying £42 for two Coke Zeros and the “buffet” is, sorry to say, excessive.
Don’t have a cup of glass for drink

Not to mention that everything was cold.

We are really disappointed.
